name: 102 Nengo no Hitotachi
source: In the near future, artificial humans have become an essential part of everyday life, quietly supporting society from behind the scenes. At his new job, Ryoujin is tasked with raising these synthetic girls — products destined to be sold to the highest bidder. But as he spends time with them, he can’t help but grow attached. When doubts about the morality of creating life begin to take root, he finds himself drawn into a conspiracy that threatens to shake the very foundations of society…
translation: 在不久的将来，人造人已成为日常生活的重要组成部分，在幕后默默地支持着社会。在他的新工作中，Ryoujin的任务是抚养这些合成女孩——这些产品注定会卖给出价最高的人。但当他与他们共度时光时，他情不自禁地对他们产生了依恋。当对创造生命的道德的怀疑开始扎根时，他发现自己陷入了一场威胁要动摇社会根基的阴谋……
